overview_description.description: Variance is an AI software company that builds autonomous AI agents to detect threats, automate investigations, and enforce policies across content, transactions, and communications. It helps businesses uncover hidden risks, streamline trust and safety workflows, and enforce compliance in real time. Their platform leverages advanced machine learning to provide actionable insights and proactive risk management.
